يستنكر (form X)
# يَسْتَنْكِرُ (yastankiru) /jas.tan.ki.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
# يُسْتَنْكَرُ (yustankaru) /jus.tan.ka.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
# يَسْتَنْكِرَ (yastankira) /jas.tan.ki.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْكَر
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
